stream.pairing: both input streams are consumed atomically, with SOF/EOL/frameid/tag checks
stream.historical_frameid: aux_frameid identifies the target current frame; original source identity is owned externally
stream.coefficients: shadow config committed on the next aligned accepted SOF at the processing stage

modules.name: img_mf_pair_join
limitations: No independent input queues, frame resynchronization, timeout, or clock-domain crossing
Input valid must not depend on ready; all participants share clk_en
Frame and tag comparison can be disabled by parameters; defaults enable both
Aligned metadata does not prove geometric or chronological alignment

modules.name: img_mf_osd_overlay
limitations: RGB888 full-raster auxiliary overlay is required even when disabled or transparent
Uniform unsigned alpha 0..256 and exact RGB color key only
No glyph rasterizer, palette, sparse rectangle fetch, premultiplied alpha, or per-pixel alpha
Three-stage elastic arithmetic honors shared CE and backpressure; latency changed, pixel and configuration contracts unchanged

modules.name: img_mf_frame_absdiff
limitations: 8-bit grayscale absolute difference and strict greater-than threshold only
Previous-frame pixels and correct historical ordering must be supplied externally
No internal frame storage, motion compensation, or automatic first-frame handling

modules.name: img_mf_background_ewma
limitations: External Q8.8 background storage and per-pixel initialized marker are required
Single running mean only; no Gaussian mixture, shadow model, or variance estimate
Update coefficient is 2^-shift for shift 0..8, with signed arithmetic truncation
Output and writeback are independently backpressured; RAM hazards and frame completion fences remain external

modules.name: img_mf_weighted_fusion
limitations: Co-registered RGB888 images with one global normalized weight only
No exposure estimation, HDR response calibration, pyramid blending, or automatic registration
Three-stage elastic arithmetic honors shared CE and backpressure; latency changed, pixel and configuration contracts unchanged

modules.name: img_mf_rgb_blend_pipe
limitations: RGB888 three-stage elastic blend with weight 0..256 and exact (a*(256-w)+b*w+128)>>8 rounding
All endpoints share clk_en; asynchronous reset flushes valid without resetting frame RAM
Internal helper; public OSD/fusion interfaces and SOF shadow-configuration behavior are preserved

modules.name: img_mf_stitch_registered
limitations: Only the overlap blend/composition subfunction is implemented as a draft
Calibration, matching, registration, homography, canvas warping and seam generation are external
Both sources must provide every canvas position with present flags, including holes
Until external-registration mode is committed, every output carries unsupported error

modules.name: img_mf_history_manager
limitations: Slot metadata ownership only; no pixel storage, DMA, burst, cache, or RAM port
Explicit caller-selected slot allocation, no automatic eviction or temporal search
Commit relies on external trusted sample counts and completion fences
Default 4 slots; valid configuration is 1..16 slots with enough slot bits

modules.name: img_mf_history_ram_adapter
limitations: Fixed geometry synchronous dual frame RAM adapter; commands 0..7 are implemented
No DDR DMA burst/cache or CDC; shared clock enable is required
New random read/write ports are optional; original capture/replay ports remain available
Reset invalidates metadata without clearing RAM; captures check SOF/EOL/frameid/tag and time out

modules.name: img_mf_dual_frame_store
limitations: Two fixed-size banks with synchronous read and no memory reset; up to 65536 pixels
Capture/replay, random dual read, writeback and current-frame Q8.8 background initialization
Direct random writes must avoid read/write address hazards; frame application schedules safe writes
No external DDR, burst DMA or CDC; resource/timing evidence applies only to the frozen 4x3 application

modules.name: img_mf_processing_bank
limitations: Four existing streaming arithmetic paths selected by a stable transaction mode
Four separate arithmetic paths; measured whole-application resource cost applies only to frozen v101b 4x3 configuration

modules.name: img_mf_frame_application
limitations: Complete fixed-frame capture/replay/OSD/difference/EWMA/fusion control
Bank1 Q8.8 background and RGB auxiliary formats are explicit caller-selected uses
Difference/background operate on input low-byte grayscale; caller converts RGB if desired
Completion waits for final output and background writeback; source starvation is bounded by capture timeout

modules.name: img_mf_translation_sad
limitations: Exhaustive bounded integer translation search over identical central ROI
Search radius 0..15; static scene and brightness consistency assumptions
No feature matching, rotation, scale estimation or robust outlier rejection
Best/second-best SAD gap threshold rejects ambiguous scenes

modules.name: img_mf_auto_stitch
limitations: Complete capture to actual SAD-result-driven frame reads, warp, blend and full canvas output
Automatic registration is integer translation only; canvas is fixed (W+2S)x(H+2S)
Optional external signed inverse homography is used for floor-nearest sampling; it is not estimated internally
Fixed canvas can crop external projective mappings; no bilinear resampling or seam optimization
Shared iterative signed-floor divider with registered partial subtraction; operation latency is longer while numerical and error contracts are preserved
Physical timing qualification covers RGB888 4x3, shift1, two ROI samples, nine trials and a 6x5 canvas at50MHz/CE1/4 only

modules.name: img_mf_dual_frame_store_bram_read
limitations: Internal autostitch store variant; original public dual-frame store remains byte-identical for v101b applications
Captured random-read request/range check, synchronous RAM read, then held response; random-read latency intentionally1 to2 enabled edges
No full-frame asynchronous RAM read or reset-clear loop

modules.name: img_mf_signed_floor_divider
limitations: Internal iterative signed division with mathematical floor for negative non-integer quotient
Fresh request captured before split magnitude/subtract/restore stages; MIN/-1 retains original W-bit wrap
Standalone W34/W36/W50 scalar/old-RTL, CE and asynchronous reset/replay regression passed
